The Life Story

The Guru

Sri Dr. Basavalinga Avadhoota

Sri Dr. Basavalinga Avadhoota is the Peethadhipati of the Mallayyagiri and Degalmadi Ashrams. Born Basavaraj Mulge on 11 July 1976 in Ratnapur, Telangana, he grew up in a cultured Lingayat family and was drawn to spiritual life from his student years.

He holds a postgraduate degree in Kannada and Philosophy with a gold medal from Karnataka University, and trained as a lab technician and homeopathy physician. After years of sadhana in the Himalayas, Kashi, Srishila and Rishikesh, he settled at Mallayyagiri in 2006 and dedicated his life to spiritual guidance and social service.

His discourses span Kannada, Telugu, Hindi, Marathi and English, and his literary work includes Anubhavaamrutha, Satya Shuddha and the vachanas signed 'Ghana Yogi Mallinatha'. More than 10,000 devotees gather at the ashram on Pournami days to listen, serve and be renewed.

Born Basavaraj Mulge, he completed his early education in his village and at the N.F.H.S. in Bidar before earning his postgraduate degree. His search for truth took him to the Himalayas, Kashi, Srishila, Rishikesh and Badrinath, and he eventually received the deeksha of knowledge from Parama Hamsa Pagal Baba.

In 2006 he came to Mallayyagiri, between Kuppanagar and Chillapalli, and made it his home. What began as a small place of sadhana has grown into an ashram where thousands gather on Pournami, where prasada is served daily, and where a village can find guidance, healing and dignity.

“Knowledge becomes wisdom only when it is lived. Live simply, serve quietly, and remember the Divine.”

Guru Vani

Milestones

A Life of Sadhana

The outward journey of a life given to the inner path — from a village in Telangana to a living seat of spiritual guidance.

01

1976

Born in Ratnapur

Born on 11 July to Rachappa and Bandemma in Ratnapur village, Nyalkal tehsil, Telangana.

02

1990s

A scholar and a seeker

Completes his education, earns an M.A. in Kannada and Philosophy with a gold medal, and trains as a lab technician.

03

2000s

Years of sadhana

Undertakes penance in the Himalayas, Kashi, Srishila, Rishikesh and Badrinath, and receives deeksha from Parama Hamsa Pagal Baba.

04

2006

Mallayyagiri Ashram

Settles between Kuppanagar and Chillapalli and begins a life of satsang, healing and service.

05

2020

Honorary doctorate

Conferred an honorary doctorate by the International Peace University of Germany at the World Peace Conference, Ooty.

06

Today

A living tradition

Guides seekers across Karnataka, Telangana, Andhra Pradesh, Maharashtra and beyond, with two ashrams and a growing body of literature.

Service & Recognition

A Seat of Service

His work has been recognised by cultural and spiritual institutions across the Deccan — but the ashram measures success in the people it serves.

  • Honorary doctorate from the International Peace University of Germany (2020)
  • Honoured by temples, associations and cultural institutions across the Deccan
  • Literary contributions in Kannada and Telugu, including vachanas and devotional songs
  • Sermons delivered in more than 2,500 towns, cities and villages

A Voice in Verse

Words That Carry the Inner Life

Alongside his discourses, Gurudev writes songs and vachanas that bring philosophy into the language of daily life.

Anubhavaamrutha

Telugu devotional songs that carry the taste of inner experience in simple, singable verse.

Satya Shuddha

Modern vachana creations in the tradition of the Sharana poets, signed 'Ghana Yogi Mallinatha'.

Oldie Haadida Hridaya Geeta

A collection of songs and reflections that bring moral and human values to everyday listeners.
